attributes.name: Tree Fort
attributes.powers:
Display this card next to a location deck. While displayed, reduce all damage dealt to each character at that location by 2 if it is not that character's turn.

While displayed, instead of the first exploration of his turn, a character at this location may recharge a random card from his discard pile.

When a bane at this location is undefeated, bury this card.
